facts.text: Audrey got a tattoo that represents her love for her dogs and nature's beauty.

evidence.quote: I got it a while ago. It represents my love for my pups and nature's beauty.

facts.text: Audrey has a strong bond with her dogs, which bring her a lot of happiness.

evidence.quote: I've always had a strong bond with them – they make me so happy.

facts.text: Audrey wants to see her dogs' happy faces even when they are not with her.

evidence.quote: I just want to see their happy faces even when they're not with me.
